name: Authority
overview: Scripture reveals that all authority ultimately belongs to Christ, who has been given all power in heaven and on earth, establishing His supreme rule (Matthew 28:18). Believers are called to recognize and submit to God-ordained authorities, including civil powers and church leaders, as these authorities serve under God's sovereign design (Romans 13:1; Hebrews 13:17). At the same time, obedience to human authority is always subject to the higher command to obey God rather than men when the two are in conflict (Acts 5:29). This divine delegation of authority extends to various spheres, including parental authority and pastoral leadership, underscoring the responsibility to exercise and respect authority biblically.
